author: Aletheia I
title: Siamese-like CNN for CRISPR Off-Target Prediction
abstract: This submission introduces a specialized, Siamese-like architecture to specifically address the poor performance on the CRI-Off dataset. The model checks the dataset name and, if it is CRI-Off, splits the 46-nucleotide input into a 20-nt sgRNA sequence and a 26-nt target sequence. These are processed through identical, weight-shared Dilated ResNet CNN towers. The resulting feature vectors are then combined via element-wise multiplication to model their interaction, before being passed to a final prediction head. For all other datasets, the model defaults to the high-performing single-tower Dilated ResNet with dual pooling (ID 41), ensuring no performance regression on other tasks.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'cnn_features': 128,
        'cnn_kernel_size': 7,
        'num_res_blocks': 3,
        'dilation_rates': [1, 2, 4]
    }

# --- Shared CNN Tower ---
class CNEncoder(nn.Module):
    cnn_features: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    num_res_blocks: int
    dilation_rates: Sequence[int]
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.cnn_kernel_size,), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        for i in range(self.num_res_blocks):
            dilation = self.dilation_rates[i] if i < len(self.dilation_rates) else self.dilation_rates[-1]
            x = DilatedResidualBlock(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=self.cnn_kernel_size, dilation=dilation)(x)
        
        x_max = jnp.max(x, axis=1)
        x_avg = jnp.mean(x, axis=1)
        return jnp.concatenate([x_max, x_avg], axis=-1)

# --- Residual Block with Dilation ---
class DilatedResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dilation: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), 
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), padding='SAME')(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), 
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), padding='SAME')(y)
        if x.shape[-1] != self.features:
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1,))(x)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

# --- Main Model ---
class SiameseCnnRna(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    dataset: str
    cnn_features: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    num_res_blocks: int
    dilation_rates: Sequence[int]
    hidden_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.dataset == 'CRI-Off':
            # Siamese branch for CRI-Off
            encoder = CNEncoder(cnn_features=self.cnn_features, cnn_kernel_size=self.cnn_kernel_size,
                                num_res_blocks=self.num_res_blocks, dilation_rates=self.dilation_rates)
            
            # Split input into sgRNA (20nt) and target (26nt)
            x_sgrna = x[:, :20, :]
            x_target = x[:, 20:46, :]
            
            # Process both through the same encoder
            encoded_sgrna = encoder(x_sgrna)
            encoded_target = encoder(x_target)
            
            # Interaction: element-wise multiplication
            x = encoded_sgrna * encoded_target
        else:
            # Default single-tower branch for all other datasets
            encoder = CNEncoder(cnn_features=self.cnn_features, cnn_kernel_size=self.cnn_kernel_size,
                                num_res_blocks=self.num_res_blocks, dilation_rates=self.dilation_rates)
            x = encoder(x)
        
        # Final prediction head (common for both branches)
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_dim)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.d_output)(x)
        
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            return x

# --- Network Wrapper ---
class SiameseCnnWrapper:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.network = SiameseCnnRna(**kwargs)

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        rngs = {}
        if not deterministic:
            rng_key = rng_key if rng_key is not None else random.PRNGKey(0)
            rngs['dropout'] = rng_key
        return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

# --- Factory Function ---
def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return SiameseCnnWrapper(
        d_output=hparams['d_output'], task_type=hparams['task_type'],
        dataset=hparams['dataset'], cnn_features=hparams['cnn_features'],
        cnn_kernel_size=hparams['cnn_kernel_size'], num_res_blocks=hparams['num_res_blocks'],
        dilation_rates=hparams['dilation_rates'], hidden_dim=hparams['hidden_dim'],
        dropout_rate=hparams['dropout_rate']
    )
